items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: we had a singer by the name of Miss Rhapsody

ctx.x: But any way, they had some argument or something, and I don't know whether Benny fired him that night or he quit, but any way Benny asked me to come with the band. So I got on the phone and called Fletcher in Chicago and told Fletcher that I wanted to stay, and Fletcher begged me to come back and I'd say Fletcher, you just can't do this to me, I'm so tired of the road and so and so and so and so. But if you insist. He said, well, John, if you just want to stay there, okay.

So I stayed in New York and went to work with Benny. And let's see now, who was on this bill? I think it was Benny Carter, and Nat, and his trio, Art Tatum, and we had a singer by the name of Miss Rhapsody. She didn't call herself Miss Raspody-- Rhapsody, it was Miss Raspody, you know. And I think this whole show cost him around $900.00 a week, you know. This was just the --
